breakdown.description: It places the overall composition at 10 wt% B, which lies outside the stated α+β tie-line interval of 25–70 wt% B, but still claims the alloy is in the α+β region.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the original overall composition (C_0 = 10 wt% B) was outside the valid range of the α+β tie line (25-70 wt% B). It resolved this inconsistency by using a corrected composition of C_0 = 40 wt% B, which aligns with the ground truth and makes the lever rule calculation physically meaningful.
